name: Green Valley of Russian River Valley

known.article: Green Valley of Russian River Valley AVA
known.via: English Wikipedia "Green Valley of Russian River Valley AVA"

climate: Most rain falls in winter. Dry summers keep mildew and rot down, though young vines may need watering.

blurb.text: A Sonoma County AVA within Russian River Valley, formerly called Sonoma County Green Valley. It covers about 36,467 acres west of the Santa Rosa Plain, in the southwestern corner of Russian River Valley.
